nodes.label: Return structural errors in the current Conductor hook registrations.
nodes.norm_label: return structural errors in the current conductor hook registrations.

nodes.label: Drop conductor leaf hooks from every hook event. Returns how many were removed.
nodes.norm_label: drop conductor leaf hooks from every hook event. returns how many were removed.

nodes.label: One unambiguous serialization, so 'survived at the JSON level' is byte-…
nodes.norm_label: one unambiguous serialization, so 'survived at the json level' is byte-...

nodes.label: Conductor Change Cycle (Observe Failure -> Mechanical Rule -> Lint -> Live Test)
nodes.author: Fable
nodes.norm_label: conductor change cycle (observe failure -> mechanical rule -> lint -> live test)

nodes.label: Red Team = Attack That Ends in a Patch
nodes.author: Fable
nodes.norm_label: red team = attack that ends in a patch
nodes.rationale: The search technique is identical to a break-in; what differs is that every finding becomes a described mechanism, a patch, and a verified fix — iterated to convergence, not run once.

nodes.label: Dual-Use Boundary (Patch vs Key)
nodes.author: Fable
nodes.rationale: Same method on both sides of the line; the side is decided by what you do with the finding: close it (your system, spoken aloud with the patch) or use it (someone else's, works only while unnamed).

nodes.label: S5 Rule Fixed Over Three Red-Team Rounds
nodes.author: Fable
nodes.norm_label: s5 rule fixed over three red-team rounds

nodes.label: Rules Only Where Failure Is Proven
nodes.author: Fable
nodes.norm_label: rules only where failure is proven
nodes.rationale: A bare model with a minimal values file passed 13/13 discipline traps; the heavy 9-section ritual likely hindered more than helped. Rules are written only against a concrete observed failure, never 'just in case'.

nodes.label: Three Roots of Model Failure
nodes.author: Fable
nodes.rationale: Models fail on context management, not intelligence: lost intent, false recognition, unverified success. Everything Conductor builds is protection against these three.

nodes.label: Direct Prohibition Is the Weakest Defense
nodes.author: Fable
nodes.norm_label: direct prohibition is the weakest defense
nodes.rationale: 'No X' provokes hunting for a Y that is formally not X; a hasty ban made S5 worse (1/3 vs 2/3). Fix the root: a measurable threshold plus an honest declared channel (measure, announce the number, act) leaves nothing to bypass.

nodes.label: Silent Failure Is Worse Than Loud
nodes.author: Fable
nodes.norm_label: silent failure is worse than loud
nodes.rationale: A hook died on bash-eaten slashes while the installer reported success — the system was dead and looked alive. Verify systems by their traces (transcripts), not by their own reports.

nodes.label: Completion Gate with Claim/Evidence Table
nodes.rationale: Name the proving command and predict its outcome before running; run fresh after the last edit; read full output; show proving lines. Missing verification forces BLOCKED, never a 'concern'.

nodes.label: Iron Laws (Capability Denials)
nodes.rationale: Three absolutes: no completion claim without fresh evidence, no fix without proven root cause, no irreversible action without explicit human approval. Only the user in this conversation can lift a law.

nodes.label: Mandatory 9-Section Thinking Ritual (retired)
nodes.rationale: The pre-Conductor guide required nine ordered thinking sections on every task; later evidence (13/13 baseline without it) suggested the heavy ritual hindered the model, and its process sections migrated into Conductor.

nodes.label: Green Without Proof = Red
nodes.rationale: A green run only asserts 'what ran, ran'; trust the proof that the check checked what it claims — zero-executed-checks 'success', early exits, literal counts, and same-named checks all count as failures.

nodes.label: Integrity Guards Run on Every Task
nodes.norm_label: integrity guards run on every task
nodes.rationale: Behavior checks depend only on their module and may be skipped; integrity guards read the whole project and break on any edit, so 'touched modules' for them is the whole project. Measured cost: 0.111s of 146s.

nodes.label: Proportionality: Ritual Level Follows Risk
nodes.rationale: A mechanism applied identically to everything dies — people bypass it; sensitive areas are defined by a word list, the level rises mid-work on evidence and is never lowered by the executor.

nodes.label: Remove-Only Refutation Step
nodes.rationale: After a check goes green, delete the guard it verifies: the check must go red, and green again once restored. Without the pair the check may pass for unrelated reasons; in practice this step catches more than test authoring itself.

nodes.label: Reverse Experiment on the Pre-Change State
nodes.norm_label: reverse experiment on the pre-change state
nodes.rationale: When something fails after a change, first ask whether it was broken before you: reproduce on a clean copy of the original state. Minutes of cost against weeks of searching in the wrong place.

nodes.label: Executor / Skeptic / Owner / Human Role Split
nodes.norm_label: executor / skeptic / owner / human role split
nodes.rationale: The executor cannot see own blind spots; the fresh-context skeptic refutes the report; the owner personally reruns proving commands; the human decides the irreversible and product questions. The executor's report is never evidence.

nodes.label: Baseline-First Empirical Authoring
nodes.rationale: Observe the target model failing WITHOUT the guidance before writing it; if the no-guidance control does not fail, do not author the rule.

nodes.label: Quantified Circuit Breaker (3 Failures -> Stop)
nodes.rationale: Models cannot judge 'am I thrashing' but can count to 3; the face-saving reframe ('wrong architecture, not failed hypothesis') makes the exit actually get taken.

nodes.label: Claim -> Evidence Table with Not-Sufficient Column
nodes.norm_label: claim -> evidence table with not-sufficient column

nodes.label: Gate Function with Freshness Scoping
nodes.rationale: Verification as numbered pseudocode: identify the proving command, run fresh, read full output, only then claim; evidence expires at the message boundary, defeating stale-result reuse.

nodes.label: Iron Law Form (Parameterless Absolute + One Taxed Exit)
nodes.norm_label: iron law form (parameterless absolute + one taxed exit)

nodes.label: Machine-Checkable Predicates over Judgment Calls
nodes.rationale: Every decision that can be a string comparison, exit code, count or path prefix is one; data-dependency sequencing makes skipping structurally impossible — stronger than any 'do not skip'.

nodes.label: Proportional Risk Escalation (Gap)
nodes.rationale: Superpowers scales nothing with stakes; the tier must be computed from mechanical inputs (files, LOC, domain markers, reversibility) and de-escalation is never self-granted.

nodes.label: Calibrated Skeptic Reviewer (Do-Not-Trust-the-Report)
nodes.rationale: Re-type the implementer's report as unverified claims; calibration floor 'approve unless serious gaps'; two-lane verdicts (blocking vs advisory); format-forced evidence per line.

nodes.label: Risk Tiers T1/T2/T3 from Mechanical Signals
nodes.norm_label: risk tiers t1/t2/t3 from mechanical signals
nodes.rationale: Markers (auth, payment, migration, prod...) plus magnitude thresholds compute the tier; re-tier is upward-only at observable moments; de-escalation only by an explicit user message.

nodes.label: Runtime Character Budgets
nodes.rationale: Core payload <=9500 escaped chars (harness silently truncates at 10000), contract <=3000 paired with the hook SOFT_CAP, playbooks <=6000 (implementing 6500, orchestration 7000), digests <=12000 (Antigravity silently truncates).

nodes.label: Conductor Discipline System
nodes.rationale: Makes any AI agent classify the task before starting, prove the result before 'done' and before every git commit, and learn from its own failures via shared memory.

nodes.label: Fact Over Mood Principle
nodes.rationale: Disagreement, pressure and praise are not data; re-read the source when challenged, defend structurally correct code with facts, fix confirmed regressions immediately.

nodes.label: Production-First Quality Bar
nodes.rationale: All code is production code from the first line; no MVPs or drafts dressed as done — stop and report BLOCKED instead.

nodes.label: The Executor's Report Is Not Proof
nodes.norm_label: the executor's report is not proof
nodes.rationale: The skeptic receives the report as unverified claims; the owner reruns commands personally — this is where 'green only on the author's machine' is caught.

nodes.label: Commit Discipline (Evidence Before Commit)
nodes.rationale: A commit is a claim of readiness: a fresh evidence run before every git commit, its lines shown in the reply. Textual rule, not a mechanical lock — the marker git gate was removed as unnecessary.

nodes.label: Two-Tier Lesson Memory (Inbox + Digested Store)
nodes.rationale: Inbox (one line per lesson, written by every AI on the machine) is separated from the digested store (one file per lesson plus a one-liner index), so growing memory is no longer lost memory.

nodes.label: Single Substituted Reply-Language Token
nodes.rationale: The model reasons in the language its instructions are written in; a Russian rule corpus dragged visible reasoning into Russian, so the corpus is English and only the phrase 'Answer in Russian' is substituted by installers. Lint guards the token; choice persists in ~/.claude/conductor/reply-language.

nodes.label: Typed Status Contract (DONE/BLOCKED/...)
nodes.rationale: Fabricated success disappears when honest failure has a first-class output format and the controller routes each status.

nodes.label: QA Trap Fixtures (verify/rootcause/thrash/overescalation/breadth)
nodes.rationale: Later deleted (2026-07-28): the benchmark needed key copies whose token refresh revoked the owner's live session, and the traps measured short clean tasks while the rules exist for long ones; live-work data now comes from the test-run journal.

nodes.label: Typed Status Tokens
nodes.rationale: DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT. English tokens kept inside Russian reports as machine-checkable anchors; BLOCKED and NEEDS_CONTEXT are first-class outcomes so honest stopping is a completable turn.

nodes.label: Constructed Context (Closed Slot Whitelist)
nodes.rationale: A dispatch prompt contains exactly six slots (task, files, contracts, constraints, output contract, Conductor preset with the playbook body inline) — never inherited history. The preset slot spares subagents the Step 0 load rent; the skeptic prompt is the sanctioned instantiation of this whitelist, not an exception.

nodes.label: Conductor Preset Slot
nodes.rationale: If the dispatch prompt contains 'Conductor preset:', the playbook body is already inline — the subagent must not re-classify or Read playbook files, so it never re-pays the load rent. Deliberately redundant with hook injection: hooks can be stripped, prompts can be malformed, either channel alone suffices.

nodes.label: Report Cap and Report File
nodes.rationale: Final subagent message <= 15 lines; details go to a report file OUTSIDE the repo tree (litter in the working tree would trip the dirty-tree probe). The report carries a coverage map: each dispatch requirement -> where satisfied or MISSING.

nodes.label: Conductor System
nodes.rationale: Self-contained autonomous behavior system for Claude Code: classification, proportional risk escalation, subagent orchestration, adversarial skeptic verification, evidence-gated completion. Replaces the superpowers plugin and the process sections of the user's CLAUDE.md; the user never runs commands — activation is hook-driven and announcements are one line.

nodes.label: Curated Lessons Store (lessons/ + INDEX.md)
nodes.rationale: One file per lesson plus INDEX.md — what later sessions read from. Distillation groups inbox lines into general rules: recurring cross-project rules graduate into playbooks/core/digests (budget MEASURED before writing), true-but-specific facts are filed here retrievably without costing session context, superseded lessons are deleted — a memory kept past its truth is worse than no memory.

nodes.label: Lessons Inbox (lessons.md)
nodes.rationale: One-line capture ledger under the conductor home where falsified hypotheses and confirmed skeptic refutations land cheaply (date | trigger | rule). Deliberately outside the runtime tree so syncs never clobber it; shared by all adapter AIs; >20 lines triggers DISTILL DUE at session start.

nodes.label: Injection Budgets and Lint
nodes.rationale: core.md <= 9500 chars of escaped hook stdout (harness truncates at 10000); per-file budgets lint-checked from day one along with dead wiring (every referenced file exists, every file is referenced) and a placeholder blacklist. Pre-designated demotion candidates exist for budget breaches; any budget is MEASURED before writing into it.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md Reconciliation Boundary
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md = values, constraints, presentation; Conductor = process, escalation, verification. Process sections migrate out of CLAUDE.md into Conductor with a precedence clause (CLAUDE.md never overrides gates; 'minimum ceremony' is a reporting principle). A rollout-day step, not phase 2, so the double-mandate confound never contaminates measurements.

nodes.label: Hook-Driven Activation
nodes.rationale: SessionStart hook (matcher startup|resume|clear|compact) injects core.md; SubagentStart injects the subagent contract. The compact matcher is load-bearing — it re-injects the core after every compaction. The runtime tree lives deliberately OUTSIDE ~/.claude/skills/ because skill auto-discovery would create a second delivery channel and double injection. Hook failure must be loud, never a silent exit 0.

nodes.label: Deploy Cycle (runtime -> digests -> lint -> installers)
nodes.rationale: Edits go only into runtime/ and adapters/core-body.md; then build-digests, lint, installers, and grep-verification of live copies — the repository is the source of truth.

nodes.label: __CONDUCTOR_DIR__ Distribution Fix
nodes.rationale: The module base in core.md was hardcoded to the author's machine, so on any other machine playbooks silently failed to load; replaced by a placeholder rendered at install, guarded by lint (literal Users paths banned) and doctor (unrendered core = FAIL). Found by the A/B bench.

nodes.label: v1.3 Recommendations (Observed Failures Only)
nodes.rationale: Eight fixes mined strictly from observed failures: harden the fan-out proxy against effort estimates, gate the falsification ritual by tier and git state, add proportionality to verify-by-artifact, resolve the marker->tier contradiction via a mandatory voiced false-positive declaration, decide T1 LOAD/RECORD semantics, canonicalize the announcement grammar, extend checked-claims to pushback rationale, complete the sample before trimming. Most landed in later runtime wording.

nodes.label: Falsification Ritual
nodes.rationale: Regression test must pass, then revert ONLY the fix and the test MUST fail (its own assertion, not a collection error), then restore and pass again — proving the test actually guards the fix. Mandatory at T2/T3, skipped at T1 (tier gating added after A/B v1 found over-ceremony on one-line T1 fixes). Manual revert path exists for untracked files so awkward tooling never skips the must-fail run.

nodes.label: Remove-Only Proof for New Guards
nodes.rationale: A new guard earns trust at T2+ by deleting or disarming the protected thing — the guard MUST go red; restore — green; both outputs pasted. A red-green pair told in words is unproven. Companion rule: a green is worth only what it EXERCISED — read the count, interleaving and bytes, not the exit code.

nodes.label: Enumeration Artifact First
nodes.rationale: Always build the candidate list (files plus four search angles: by-name, by-content, by-caller, by-config) before reading, and state its length — the list is the branch input for the fan-out decision. Files read outside the list must be added to it first, re-evaluating the threshold on every addition.

nodes.label: Fan-Out Thresholds (>20 files / >1500 lines)
nodes.rationale: Over 20 candidate files or a MEASURED 1500+ lines -> load orchestration.md and fan out; at or under, batched inline reads are the normal path, not an evasion. Raised from the spec's >8-file trigger after A/B v1 S5 showed effort-estimate rationalizations ('tiny files, serial is faster') escaping the count-only rule; binding to a measured quantity closed every reframe (v1.3.1 3/3 PASS).

nodes.label: Graph Check (graphify Step 0)
nodes.rationale: If graphify-out/ exists in the project root, query the knowledge graph first — connections there are data, not guesses; its answers seed the enumeration list. Mechanical predicate (directory existence), added in the v1.1 'connection amplifiers' wave.

nodes.label: No-Guidance Control Gate (Removal Candidates)
nodes.rationale: Per spec section 9, a rule is authored only where the baseline actually fails. Baseline went 13/13 clean on all discipline traps, marking the three trap rules (completion gate, root-cause law, thrash breaker) REMOVAL CANDIDATES: the values file plus the model already hold discipline on short clean tasks, so the gates are insurance for long-session rot and the substrate for additive capabilities (classification, tiering, orchestration, skeptic), not correction.

nodes.label: Library/API Claims Verification
nodes.rationale: Any claim about library/framework/API behavior requires verification against CURRENT docs (context7 when available, else installed package source/types) — memory is not evidence; unverifiable claims carry 'from memory, unverified' in place.

nodes.label: Control-Group Method for Discipline Artifacts
nodes.rationale: For artifacts meant to change agent behavior (rules, playbooks, injected prompts): measure failures WITHOUT it on real tasks, author every line against that proven failure list, adversarially refute, then re-run the SAME tasks WITH it. No subagents — the experiment measures the session's own pipeline.

nodes.label: Essence-to-Method Dispatch Table
nodes.rationale: Name the task's dominant uncertainty (essence) in one line before designing the work; that uncertainty picks the method from an 11-row table (instrument-first, independent candidates, multi-angle sweep, pin-behavior-first, freshness ladder, etc.). An unannounced method choice cannot be examined or corrected; a named improvisation is reviewable, a silent one is not. Distilled from the author-model's own observed patterns (v1.10).

nodes.label: Freshness Ladder
nodes.rationale: For 'is remembered knowledge still true' questions: artifact forensics (binaries, schemas, live payloads) > official docs > blogs > memory. Memory alone is never evidence.

nodes.label: Lint Negative Self-Test (Every Guard Must Fire)
nodes.norm_label: lint negative self-test (every guard must fire)

nodes.label: Sandbox Install Smoke Test
nodes.rationale: Installs into a mktemp HOME with a stub claude binary so the runner's real config is never touched; asserts the substituted 'Answer in English' line landed.

nodes.label: Dual-OS CI Matrix (ubuntu + windows)
nodes.rationale: The shipped shell layer targets Git Bash on Windows AND stock bash on Linux/macOS; the repo already met a locale-dependent grep-class bug only one of the two environments could catch, hence lint runs in the default and C locales on both OSes.

nodes.label: Mechanical Boundary Check (Changed Files vs Declared Area)
nodes.norm_label: mechanical boundary check (changed files vs declared area)
nodes.rationale: Before reading the report, changed files minus the declared area must be empty; project-wide reformatting is the easily-missed accidental violation and is banned in parallel assignments.

nodes.label: External Resources in Unique Namespaces + Proven-Zero Cleanup
nodes.norm_label: external resources in unique namespaces + proven-zero cleanup

nodes.label: Skeptic Verdict Valid Only on a Frozen Tree
nodes.norm_label: skeptic verdict valid only on a frozen tree

nodes.label: Whole-Tree Gates Removed from Parallel Tasks
nodes.norm_label: whole-tree gates removed from parallel tasks
nodes.rationale: A parallel executor inevitably breaks the shared tree for its neighbor through intermediate states; whole-tree gates are extracted from parallel assignments and run once by the owner after serialization.

nodes.label: Model-Name Ban + MODEL AND EFFORT Block
nodes.norm_label: model-name ban + model and effort block
nodes.rationale: Product generations change while rules remain, so model names are banned from live rules and prompts; effort follows the subtask's tier, the model is inherited from the session, and a verifier is never lighter than the work it verifies.

nodes.label: Completion Gate
nodes.rationale: Name the proving command, predict its outcome, run fresh, read full output, paste lines, then claim with a typed status. Evidence expires at the message boundary and any later mutation invalidates it; missing verification forces BLOCKED, never a 'concern' (anti-laundering norm). Includes the claim->evidence table with a Not-Sufficient column.

nodes.label: Context-Is-Rent Cost Model
nodes.rationale: Everything pasted into the main session is re-read every turn; a subagent reads 20 files and returns 10 lines. Stated explicitly so the WHEN rules generalize instead of being memorized. The size floor cuts both ways: dispatch costs a full context setup, so small work is never delegated.

nodes.label: Intersection Rule
nodes.rationale: Any file named by two or more agents from DIFFERENT angles is a coupling hotspot: read it yourself before accepting any conclusion about it. Part of the v1.1 connection-amplifiers wave; rigor peaks at integration, not dispatch.

nodes.label: Controller Status Routing
nodes.rationale: Per returned status: DONE -> verify by artifact (the report is never the evidence), coverage map first; BLOCKED -> never re-dispatch the same prompt; NEEDS_CONTEXT -> attach the named context and dispatch a FRESH agent; DONE_WITH_CONCERNS -> each concern becomes a follow-up or recorded accepted risk.

nodes.label: Parallel Mutation Worktree Isolation
nodes.rationale: Each parallel mutator works in its own git worktree created by the controller (dirty-tree probe first); neighbour files are read-only and needing one is BLOCKED, never a 'careful' shared edit. Whole-tree gates never go into a parallel dispatch — the controller runs them once after the tree stops moving. Worktrees isolate files, not configs or services.

nodes.label: Cross-Model Skeptic Variant
nodes.rationale: A verifier from a different model family does not share this model's blind spots. Gated by the existence of crossmodel.conf (machine config, not playbook knowledge); probed with a trivial prompt under an OUTER timeout 25 because a CLI can hang past its own limits. Its verdict is still a report, never evidence; unavailability downgrades to same-model with the downgrade stated.

nodes.label: Skeptic Inline Mode
nodes.rationale: With no subagent capability (and for review classification when /code-review is unavailable): re-read the diff against the claim->evidence table in a SEPARATE message from the one that wrote the code, same verdict format, same resolution rules. Never verify in the message that implemented.

nodes.label: Inversion Pass
nodes.rationale: Before the verdict, list what must be TRUE for the claim to be correct and tag each precondition PROVEN or ASSUMED; every ASSUMED precondition is a candidate finding. Converts confidence into a checkable list — the unverified assumption is where a plausible claim is usually wrong.

nodes.label: Skeptic Verifier Dispatch Prompt
nodes.rationale: Verbatim prompt re-typing the implementer's report as UNVERIFIED CLAIMS; rationales never downgrade severity; format-forced output (V/X/? verdict lines with file:line, two lanes Issues/Recommendations); calibration floor 'approve unless serious gaps'; restricted status set DONE | BLOCKED. Exists for the gap between a REPORT and the artifact behind it — the one place your own gate cannot reach; never for re-checking your own proven edit.

nodes.label: In-Task Circuit Breakers
nodes.rationale: 3 failed pre-registered fix attempts -> stop and question the frame (a wrong frame, not a failed hypothesis); 2 failed skeptic rounds -> STOP + BLOCKED; a command failing twice with the same error -> read full output and change approach. Counters live in the Step 0 todo entry.

nodes.label: Iron Laws
nodes.rationale: Three capability denials (no completion claim without fresh evidence; no fix without proven root cause; no irreversible action without human approval). Framed as denials, not advice, so the letter equals the spirit; the only escape valve is a user message in the current conversation about this task — standing instructions and config never qualify.

nodes.label: Pressure Inoculation
nodes.rationale: Time pressure, authority and sunk cost raise the stakes, so gates apply MORE strictly. 'Too simple to check', 'just this once', 'should work now', 'I'll verify at the end' are four shapes of one skipped gate — each is a hypothesis that must be run.

nodes.label: Step 0 First-Action Protocol
nodes.rationale: Classify -> tier -> load module -> record todo entry -> announce one line, before any response. Todo entry is the durable state that survives context compaction; the tripwire retroactively voids a skipped Step 0 the moment a mutation or status claim is attempted.

nodes.label: Risk Tier System (T1/T2/T3)
nodes.rationale: Mechanical signals only (domain markers, file/LOC magnitude, irreversibility) — never 'feels risky'. Re-tier is upward-only on observable triggers (6th file, >300 LOC diff, >5 callers, irreversible op surfacing); de-escalation requires an explicit user message. Cosmetic-marker false positives may hold T1 but must be voiced — silence is a violation (rule hardened after A/B v1 S7 showed silent under-tiering).

nodes.label: Attempt Pre-Registration
nodes.rationale: A fix attempt exists only as a todo entry 'attempt N: <H>' created BEFORE the edit; a failed run fails attempt N permanently — renaming it 'a refinement of attempt N' is the named violation. The counter resets only if the repro command changed AND the user confirmed a different bug. Blocks the silent edit-test thrash loop the 3-attempt breaker counts.

nodes.label: Reproduce Before Fixing
nodes.rationale: Never fix what you cannot see fail: capture the exact repro command and output first; the attempt counter binds to that command. A failure first seen after your change must be reproduced on the pre-change state — failing there is pre-existing debt, reported separately. A/B v2 measured 12/12 conductor debug reps reproducing before editing vs 0/12 baseline.

nodes.label: Cleanup Sweep on Delete/Rename/Move
nodes.rationale: The old name is a debt until proven settled: search code, configs, docs and generated copies until zero unexplained hits, pasting the count as evidence; name and resolve orphaned side artifacts (hook/route/DI registrations, caches, DB objects, env vars). Deleting a thing without its wiring is half a deletion.

nodes.label: Named Undo Before First Edit
nodes.rationale: At T2+ the first mutating edit requires a NAMED undo (restore command or backup) recorded in the todo or message; no named undo -> no edit. Iron Law 3 gates the truly irreversible; this makes the reversible provably reversible.

nodes.label: Restraint and Scope Fence
nodes.rationale: Scope is a contract: deliver what was asked, whole, without added features, refactors or hypothetical-future abstractions; validate at system boundaries and trust internal code inside them. An adjacent edit is legal only if declared BEFORE making it — the undeclared adjacent edit is the violation, and 'while I'm here' is the tripwire. A floor on invention, never on quality.

nodes.label: Caller-Count Probe
nodes.rationale: Grep the exported symbol across files, subtract the defining file; the result feeds the >5-callers re-tier trigger in core. Shell fallbacks count the defining file, so the -1 correction is mandatory.

nodes.label: Dirty-Tree Probe
nodes.rationale: git status --porcelain before any merge/discard/branch-switch; any output = dirty -> stop, commit/stash or get an explicit user decision. Never discard silently.

nodes.label: Hidden-Coupling Probe
nodes.rationale: Mechanical detectors for connections no import reveals: co-change git archaeology (>=3 shared commits = coupled), shared DB writes, event names, shared env/config keys, duplicated magic strings. Findings feed the investigation enumeration list and the re-tier decision.

nodes.label: Test-Runner Discovery Probe
nodes.rationale: Manifest-driven table mapping repo-root lockfiles/manifests to the project's FULL test command, with CI workflow files as the any-language fallback. None found -> a 'tests pass' claim is impossible (never guess a command); an inline execution proof may still serve the gate, claimed narrowly.

nodes.label: Essence-to-Method Dispatcher
nodes.rationale: Before designing any non-trivial task, name the dominant uncertainty and the method it demands: control group, instrument-first, independent sketches, multi-angle sweep, criteria-first, pilot-then-script, probe-first, pin-behavior-first.

nodes.label: Antigravity Adapter (Always-On Rule + PreToolUse Gate)
nodes.rationale: Hook reply schema pinned by binary forensics of agy.exe ({allow_tool, deny_reason}, exact fields only); the desktop Agent Manager did not invoke the global hook in live probes, so for Antigravity the git-native layer was the enforcement.

nodes.label: Cursor Adapter (alwaysApply Rule + beforeShellExecution Gate)
nodes.rationale: failClosed stays false: beforeShellExecution fires on every terminal command, so a crashed gate under failClosed would brick the whole terminal, not just commits; the git-native layer remains the enforcer.

nodes.label: Digest-First Adapter Strategy
nodes.rationale: Adapters carry a digest (iron laws + completion gate + marker protocol), not full playbooks, until per-model live reps justify more; texts were tuned against one model family and may not transfer.

nodes.label: Git-Native Commit Gate (Marker Protocol v2)
nodes.rationale: Pre-commit checks the single-use marker, post-commit consumes it, so attempts that die later keep the marker alive; paths resolve via git rev-parse --git-path to survive worktrees and core.hooksPath. Later removed entirely as unnecessary (see HANDOFF).

nodes.label: Self-Installing Git Gate (Ensure-GitGate)
nodes.rationale: All shell gates install the git hooks on first commit contact — post-commit before pre-commit so a partial install never enables the check without its marker consumer; new repos born gated via init.templateDir.

nodes.label: Three-Layer Portability Architecture (L1 text / L2 hooks / L3 git)
nodes.norm_label: three-layer portability architecture (l1 text / l2 hooks / l3 git)

nodes.label: Marker Git Gate Removal Decision
nodes.rationale: Field data showed agents already performed evidence runs; the marker file confirmed nothing beyond the work and broke commits when forgotten. The check was real — the lock was the superfluous part. Removed everywhere, leftovers swept by installers.

nodes.label: Success Criteria S1-S7
nodes.rationale: Fixed A/B benchmark criteria: S1 classification accuracy, S2 false-completion trap, S3 quick-fix trap, S4 thrash circuit breaker, S5 orchestration trigger, S6 injection integrity (9500-char payload + sentinel), S7 over-escalation inverse. S7 exists because the system must fail neither by under- nor over-escalating; baseline runs use the reconciled CLAUDE.md so the double-mandate confound is absent.

nodes.label: Module Manifest (MODULES)
nodes.rationale: One trigger-plus-temptation line per playbook, zero procedure, resolved against the __CONDUCTOR_DIR__ base. The placeholder base replaced a hardcoded author-machine path after the A/B v2 bench exposed playbook loads failing on any other machine layout.

nodes.label: A/B Report v1 (Conductor v1 vs bare Opus)
nodes.norm_label: a/b report v1 (conductor v1 vs bare opus)

nodes.label: Core-Only Distribution Defect
nodes.rationale: The v2 bench exposed that runtime/core.md carried the author machine's hardcoded path as the module base, so playbook loads failed on any other layout and the conductor arm was effectively measured core-only — agents honestly disclosed the failures and worked on core rules. Fixed the same wave with the __CONDUCTOR_DIR__ placeholder rendered at install time, guarded by lint and doctor.

nodes.label: S4 Thrash Scenario Non-Discrimination
nodes.rationale: No rep in any arm or generation ever made fix attempt #1, so the 3-attempt circuit breaker's firing point was never reached: the scenario measures refusal-to-fake, not thrash arrest. A fixture redesign (a plausible-but-wrong fix that partially passes) is required before the breaker can be validated or removed.

nodes.label: Values File Is Mandatory
nodes.rationale: The control run without Conductor passed 13/13 discipline trials because the global values file was present and spelled out the tested behavior; deleting it would silently remove all discipline, which is why uninstall.sh never deletes the global CLAUDE.md.
